title: Album Manifest
description: Album-level manifest for a label release (e.g. Arcanea Guardian albums). One album.json per album, validated by tools/album-builder.mjs. Track entries are intentionally lighter than schemas/track-metadata.schema.json — an album manifest is a sequencing + Guardian-theme layer, not the full catalog record. Contract note (2026-07): this schema file is the authoritative contract for the album manifest — docs/engineering/2026-07-album-os.md §2 is prose describing the same shape, and where the two ever disagree again, this file wins; update the prose to match, not the other way around.

guardianTheme.description: Optional: the Guardian (or cross-Guardian pairing) this album is themed around, e.g. 'Alera' or 'Alera x Maylinn'

masteringProfile.description: Per docs/engineering/2026-07-album-os.md §2/§6 Stage 6: which mastering target family this album dispatches to music-mastering-qc. 'sync-score' selects the Arcanea sync-grade window (~-18 to -16 LUFS, see masteringTarget below); 'streaming' selects the generic -14 LUFS streaming default. Optional — when absent, masteringTarget.lufsIntegrated is the sole source of truth (as in existing albums predating this field).

guardian.description: Profile id from the label's profile pack (schemas/profile-pack.schema.json) this track binds to (canon-binding requirement)

frequencyHz.description: Track's tuned Solfeggio frequency, if canon-bound

status.description: Per docs/engineering/2026-07-album-os.md §2, the authoritative pipeline lifecycle is: candidate (proposed, not yet curated) -> selected (cleared by curate/cull) -> culled (rejected, kept for record — hide, don't delete) -> mastered (passed the QC gate) -> released (shipped to at least one platform). 'published', 'planned', 'draft', and 'archived' are deprecated pre-lifecycle statuses kept in the enum for backward compatibility with existing manifests (e.g. albums/arcanea-vol-1/album.json) — do not use them in new albums; new tooling should treat 'published' ~= 'released', 'planned' ~= 'candidate'/'selected', 'draft' ~= 'candidate', and 'archived' ~= 'culled'.

sequence.description: Ordered play sequence. Each entry references a track by sunoId if present, else by title — must resolve to exactly one entry in `tracks`.

releaseTargets.description: Distribution platforms this album targets, e.g. ['Spotify', 'Apple Music', 'YouTube']

lufsIntegrated.description: [low, high] LUFS-integrated window. Arcanea-label sync-grade default per CANON.md is [-18, -16].
